articles.title: France orders country's internet service providers to block Polymarket
articles.snippet: The regulator cited concerns over addictive mechanics, a lack of self-exclusion tools, and a high volume of French users bypassing previous financial restrictions.

articles.title: French gambling regulator orders ISPs to block Polymarket
articles.snippet: Autorité nationale des jeux has ordered France’s internet service providers to geoblock Polymarket, citing illegal gambling and market manipulation concerns.

articles.title: ECB Warns Stablecoins May Drain Bank Deposits—Here's What That Means
articles.snippet: ECB board member Piero Cipollone laid out the three-layer threat banks face from digital payments, and pitched the digital euro as the only structural answer.

articles.title: Three Men Jailed for Posing as Police in $5.3M UK Crypto Fraud
articles.snippet: The gang built fake police websites to fool victims, then spent the stolen crypto on Rolexes and luxury holidays, the Met said.

articles.title: Base Creator Jesse Pollak Steps Back From App Leadership After Admitting Social Bet 'Was Wrong'
articles.snippet: Pollak said he is handing the Base App back to Coinbase to focus on building Base into "the blockchain for global finance" after conceding the network's push into on-chain social missed the mark.
